column1: # Harbor as a pull-through cache for every registry the cluster pulls from (update-setup-07).
# Read by registry/proxy-cache.sh (Harbor's side), registry/kind-trust.sh (the nodes' side) and
# registry/scanning.sh (scan on arrival). Adding a registry: one line, then re-run the three
# scripts - and add it to the Trivy Operator's trivy.registry.mirror map in
# platformservices/trivy-operator/kustomization.yaml, so its scan jobs use the mirror too.
